title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next UD-Q4_K_XL — RTX PRO 6000 llama.cpp + MTP
slug_note: Vendor-claimed 170 tok/s single-stream on one RTX PRO 6000 with the shared MTP module, up from a ~100 tok/s baseline.

variation.quant_detail: UD-Q4_K_XL (111.3GB) + a shared Q8_0 MTP module (2.79GB); quant mapped from the guide, the vendor chart does not restate it per point

engine.config: Unsloth GGUFs with the shared MTP module via llama.cpp (or Unsloth Desktop, where MTP is on by default).

requirements.notes: 111.3GB UD-Q4_K_XL + ~2.8GB shared MTP module; fits a single 96GB card only with the PLE table offloaded (Unsloth sizes the 4-bit lane at 96-114GB). Treat the 96GB fit as tight.

measurements.context: vendor chart: '170 tokens/s on 1x RTX 6000 PRO GPU compared to the 100 token baseline', UD-Q4_K_XL + shared Q8_0 MTP; quant mapped from the guide, not restated on the chart

caveats: Vendor claim (unsloth), not an independent reproduction. The docs chart does not re-state quant/context per point.
RTX PRO 6000 has two editions with different bandwidth (Workstation 1792 GB/s, Server 1597 GB/s); the claim does not say which.
The 4-bit lane is 111GB of weights; on a 96GB card it needs the PLE table offloaded, so the 170 tok/s figure assumes that configuration.

sources.note: the guide: MTP run command and the 170 tok/s on RTX PRO 6000 chart
